title: China’s Vanishing Muslims: Undercover In The Most Dystopian Place In The World
summary: VICE News reporter Isobel Yeung goes undercover as a tourist in Xinjiang, documenting heavy surveillance, policing and internment of Uighurs. It also covers children taken into state-run institutions.
why: HN cites it as first-hand, independent reporting on Xinjiang that does not rely on state-sanctioned access.

quote.text: here's a very thorough look from an established news source
